name: std::operator<<(std::basic_stacktrace)
intro: Inserts the description of st into the output stream os. Equivalent to return os << std::to_string(st);.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
os

 -

  an output stream


  st

 -

  a basic_stacktrace whose description is to be inserted
